description: A gamified social reading tracker built on React Native & Supabase, leveraging Realtime subscriptions to track peer progress dynamically.

frontend.routing: Expo Router v3 (File-based routing with deep linking)
frontend.styling: Constants-driven dynamic StyleSheet (Colors, Spacing, Radii tokens)

schema.public.users: Extended profile data linked to auth.users via foreign key cascade.
schema.public.books: Cached book metadata to mitigate Google Books API rate limits.
schema.public.reading_rooms: One-to-one mapping with books acting as multiplayer hubs.
schema.public.reading_progress: Tracking matrix (user_id x book_id) with unique constraints to map current chapter.
schema.public.chapter_reactions: Discrete reaction payload per chapter per user.
schema.public.feed_events: Event sourcing table tracking system-wide user actions.

triggers.name: handle_new_user
triggers.action: Bypasses RLS to instantiate public.users row with metadata safely.

triggers.name: handle_progress_xp
triggers.action: Calculates chapter deltas and mathematically increments public.users.xp (+10 per chapter).

google_books_api.behavior: Search queries pass through dynamic URI encoding; fetching is routed through a debounced React hook.

data_flow.room_subscription: useReadingRoom.ts mounts -> Fetches initial states -> Subscribes to Supabase Postgres 'UPDATE/INSERT' channels -> Receives payload -> Mutates Zustand roomStore -> React triggers UI re-render.

known_issues_and_limitations.impact: High. Unauthenticated traffic from the same IP block rapidly triggers Google's quota limits.
known_issues_and_limitations.mitigation: Implemented a mock fallback payload intercept in googleBooks.ts that renders static books if a 429 status is thrown.

known_issues_and_limitations.impact: Low. Supabase JS client types for Foreign Key joins evaluate deeply nested profiles as arrays rather than discrete objects natively.
known_issues_and_limitations.mitigation: Bypassed with `as unknown as Type` cast in profile.tsx to satisfy compiler warnings.

known_issues_and_limitations.impact: Resolved. Previously, attempting client-side insert into public.users during signUp violated RLS if email confirmations delayed the JWT token creation.
known_issues_and_limitations.mitigation: Shifted responsibility entirely to a Postgres Database Trigger (handle_new_user) operating securely beyond RLS.

known_issues_and_limitations.impact: Resolved. router.replace triggered infinite looping if navigation tree wasn't mounted during auth resolution.
known_issues_and_limitations.mitigation: Guarded by useSegments and useRootNavigationState hooks in _layout.tsx.
